qa_pairs.question: What special tools are needed to remove the bracket for left or right control arm?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tools 31 2 151 and 00 7 500 are needed to pull the bracket off the control arm.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if you reuse a rubber mount that has been pulled off dry?
qa_pairs.answer: The rubberized inner sleeve will be destroyed when pulled off dry, so never reuse a rubber mount pulled out of the control arm.

qa_pairs.question: What is the proper procedure for installing the control arm bracket on the body?
qa_pairs.answer: Bolt bracket on body immediately, use tightening torque specified, load down car to normal position, and leave car in normal position at least 30 minutes to avoid any suspension movement.

qa_pairs.question: What tool should be used for All Wheel Drive vehicles instead of Special Tool 31 2 153?
qa_pairs.answer: For All Wheel Drive vehicles, use Special Tool 31 2 155 instead of Special Tool 31 2 153.

qa_pairs.question: What part number should be used to replace the rubber mounts?
qa_pairs.answer: Always replace rubber mounts with part number 31 12 130, and use mounts of same make as visible on the mount.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the control arm journal during installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Coat the control arm journal with an approved lubricant and engage Special Tool 31 2 153 in the control arm bore.

qa_pairs.question: What is the first step when removing the control arm bracket?
qa_pairs.answer: Punch mark center of control arm, then unscrew control arm bracket and remove heat shield if applicable.

qa_pairs.question: Why must the car be left in normal position for at least 30 minutes after installation?
qa_pairs.answer: The lubricant will evaporate after 30 minutes so that the control arm fits tight and is positioned correctly in the rubber mount.

qa_pairs.question: What callout numbers are shown in the control arm removal diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The diagram shows callout numbers 31 2 154, 31 2 152, 31 2 153, and 00 7 501.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if the installation procedures are not followed correctly?
qa_pairs.answer: Non conformance with these procedures could impair handling considerably.

qa_pairs.question: What is noted about centering bores in the bracket installation?
qa_pairs.answer: The note states that centering bores (large diameter) of bracket face engine carrier.
